Abstract.AbstractText: This paper investigates the synchronization problem for the realization-dependent probabilistic Boolean networks (PBNs) coupled unidirectionally in the drive-response configuration. The realization of the response PBN is assumed to be uniquely determined by the realization signal generated by the drive PBN at each discrete time instant. First, the drive-response PBNs are expressed in their algebraic forms based on the semitensor product method, and then, a necessary and sufficient condition is presented for the synchronization of the PBNs. Second, by resorting to a newly defined matrix operator, the reachable set from any initial state is expressed by a column vector. Consequently, an easily computable algebraic criterion is derived assuring the synchronization of the drive-response PBNs. Finally, three illustrative examples are employed to demonstrate the applicability and usefulness of the developed theoretical results.

Article.ArticleTitle: Synchronization for the Realization-Dependent Probabilistic Boolean Networks.
